propositions: normalize_coverage_records validates the entire response against an extra-forbid payload model, so standard runner metadata triggers a validation error.
When validation fails, every expected record is converted to indeterminate/output-invalid.
The live singleton evaluation reproduces recall 0.0 and validity 0.0 while the same request passes when inspected directly.
Normalization should apply only to the registered records payload while metadata fields runner, model, trace_id, and _usage are ignored.
Unknown fields inside the records payload must continue to be rejected fail-closed, along with malformed, missing, duplicate, and cross-attributed records.
